name: Turn System
description: Global map-turn clock. A saved turn counter advances on each room entry (and via the turn action/service), ticking limited status durations and stack_bleeding statuses on all characters and firing turn_advanced. Adds a Wait button to the map toolbar.
author: Nekon

show_turn_counter.tooltip: Show the current turn number next to the Wait button in the map toolbar.

status_meta.description: Stacks lost per adventure turn (turn_system tick). 0/absent = no bleeding. The status is removed when it bleeds to 0 stacks.
